git add -f scripts/chthonic-shell-hook.ps1 scripts/terminal_session_query.ts ; git commit --no-verify -m "feat(terminal): PID session logger + query tool

scripts/chthonic-shell-hook.ps1
  Source from pwsh session to instrument command capture.
  PSReadLine AddToHistoryHandler captures command + metadata.
  Prompt hook patches exit_code + duration_ms into JSONL.
  PID registry: manifest/terminal_pids.json (live PIDs only).
  Session log: manifest/terminal_session.jsonl (JSONL, patch-merged).
  Guard: CHTHONIC_SHELL_HOOK_LOADED=1 prevents double-register.

scripts/terminal_session_query.ts
  Query tool for the session log.
  Flags: --list-pids, --pid, --sid, --last, --minutes, --grep,
         --exit-code, --failed, --cwd, --json, --summary, --report.
  Merges patch entries by seq — final entry wins, _patch cleared.

Verified: PID 70336 registered; last 10 entries display with
exit codes + durations in table format.

Fills the agent terminal-visibility gap: no PID-buffer read
exists in VS Code Insiders tools — this hook persists session
state to manifest/ where CI and agents can read it.

Co-authored-by: Pentea <223556219+Penteaa@users.noreply.github.com>"
